def min_swaps_to_transform(n, p, s):
    # Create a list of indices for each number in p and s
    p_indices = [[] for _ in range(n + 1)]
    s_indices = [[] for _ in range(n + 1)]
    
    for i, num in enumerate(p):
        p_indices[num].append(i)
    for i, num in enumerate(s):
        s_indices[num].append(i)
    
    # Check if the positions of each number in p and s are the same
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        if p_indices[i] != s_indices[i]:
            break
    else:
        return 0, []
    
    # Find the position to swap to minimize the cost
    min_cost = float('inf')
    best_swap = []
    
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(n):
            if p[i] != s[j]:
                # Swap p[i] and p[j]
                p[i], p[j] = p[j], p[i]
                # Calculate the cost of this swap
                cost = abs(i - j)
                if cost < min_cost:
                    min_cost = cost
                    best_swap = [(i + 1, j + 1)]
                # Swap back p[i] and p[j]
                p[i], p[j] = p[j], p[i]
    
    return min_cost, best_swap

# Read input
